title: Projects
subtitle: Selected work — platforms I've built and scaled.

items.title: Creazilla
items.summary: Backend for a platform serving 10M+ free graphics with Elasticsearch search and Redis caching.
items.challenge: Serve millions of graphic assets with fast search and stable performance under high traffic.
approach: Architected backend with NestJS and queue-based processing
Redis caching and Bull Queue for background jobs

items.title: Kaluwala.in
items.summary: Village tourism platform with Sanity CMS and a Telegram bot for community photo contributions.
items.challenge: Enable easy content contributions from a remote village with moderation and real-time blog alerts.
approach: Next.js tourism site with SEO-first structure
Sanity CMS for blog and content management
Telegram bot on Cloudflare Workers for uploads

items.title: ExploreWithNurse
items.summary: Travel blog with headless CMS, SEO-optimised pages, and strong Core Web Vitals.
items.challenge: A performant blog that ranks well and works on slow mobile networks with self-service publishing.
approach: Deployed on Vercel with edge caching
